findings.title: Complete Absence of Authentication and Authorization
findings.remediation: Add JWT authentication middleware globally in app.ts before all /api/* routes. Implement RBAC (viewer/operator/admin). Derive actor identity from token, never from request body. Protect /metrics with bearer token.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass via Unauthenticated Force-Approve
findings.objective_achieved: Bypass work item state machine to reach an invalid status
findings.remediation: All approval endpoints (/approve, /force-approve, /deny) must require authenticated admin role. Rate-limit to 5/min. Log as audit event.

findings.title: Full Data Exfiltration via Unbounded Pagination
findings.objective_achieved: Enumerate all work items without pagination limit enforcement
findings.remediation: Implement server-side pagination with hard max of 100. Return {data, total, page, limit, totalPages}. Return HTTP 400 for invalid limit/page.

findings.title: Stored XSS via Unvalidated Title and Description Fields
findings.remediation: Apply server-side HTML sanitization (sanitize-html or DOMPurify) before storing. Use text-only React rendering. Add Content-Security-Policy header via Helmet.

findings.title: Webhook Intake Lacks HMAC/Signature Verification
findings.remediation: Verify X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature via HMAC-SHA256 against ZENDESK_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var. Require bearer token for /automated endpoint.

findings.title: Unvalidated Enum Inputs in Intake Webhook
findings.remediation: Apply Object.values(WorkItemType).includes(body.type) validation in all intake routes. Reject HTTP 400 for invalid enum values.

findings.title: Soft-Delete Creates Permanent Dispatch Denial-of-Service
findings.remediation: Cascade-remove soft-deleted item IDs from all dependency arrays. Treat undefined blocker as resolved, not unresolved. Alternatively implement hard-delete.

findings.title: All Four Required Audit Events Missing
findings.remediation: Add audit severity level to logger. Emit typed events: login_attempt, permission_denied, state_transition, data_export.

findings.title: No Data Encryption at Rest — In-Memory Ephemeral Store
findings.remediation: Migrate to PostgreSQL or SQLite with encrypted storage. Document data types permitted until migration.

findings.title: Soft-Deleted Item IDOR via Dependency References
findings.objective_achieved: Access or modify a soft-deleted work item via direct ID reference
findings.remediation: On soft-delete, cascade-remove item ID from all blocked_by and blocks arrays. Filter soft-deleted IDs from dependency payloads.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting — Request Flood Confirmed
findings.remediation: Add express-rate-limit globally (100 req/min GETs, 20 req/min POSTs). Tighter limits on approve/force-approve/deny/vote endpoints.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Dashboard Exposes Full Internal State
findings.remediation: Require read-only authenticated session for all dashboard endpoints.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Leaked to HTTP Clients
findings.remediation: Return generic 500 messages to clients. Log full error internally. Call next(err) to use existing errorHandler middleware.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers
findings.remediation: npm install helmet; app.use(helmet()) as first middleware. Tune CSP. One-line fix.

findings.title: iframe Debug Portal Missing sandbox Attribute
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" and CSP frame-src restricted to expected portal origin.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics Endpoint
findings.remediation: Add bearer-token middleware to /metrics keyed by METRICS_TOKEN env var, or bind to internal-only port.

findings.title: Cascade Dispatch DoS via Deep Dependency Chain
findings.remediation: Move cascade dispatch to async queue. Add maximum cascade breadth limit of 50 per resolution event.

findings.title: Negative Page Number Causes Unexpected Slice Behavior
findings.remediation: Enforce Math.max(1, page) before computing offset. Return HTTP 400 for non-positive page values.

findings.title: Soft Delete Does Not Satisfy Right-to-Erasure (GDPR Art. 17)
findings.remediation: Implement hard-delete that physically removes or anonymizes records. Add data retention TTL (90 days for completed/rejected items).

findings.title: No Formal CORS Policy (Partially Mitigated in Live Test)
findings.notes: Red team found CORS correctly restricts evil origins during live testing. Risk lower than static analysis indicated.
findings.remediation: Add cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS }) middleware. Set ALLOWED_ORIGINS in .env.

findings.title: Route Override Stores Arbitrary String in item.route
findings.remediation: Validate overrideRoute against WorkItemRoute enum before storing. Return HTTP 400 for unknown values.
